events.description: A silver sedan in the left lane abruptly swerves right into the path of a black SUV, causing a collision. The impact occurs around t=5.5s, with visible vehicle deformation and debris (e.g., small dark object airborne at f10–f12). The vehicles remain interlocked or in close contact through f15.
A black sedan in the right lane collides with a red car, causing the black car to spin violently, emit smoke, and shed debris; the red car is pushed sideways off the road.

A dark-colored vehicle in the right lane loses control, spins violently, and collides with the guardrail or roadside, producing a large cloud of dust/debris; the vehicle appears to roll or slide sideways before coming to rest off the road.
A dark-colored sedan is seen overturned on the right shoulder/ditch, having crashed off the road; the vehicle is stationary and clearly damaged.

A blue sedan is seen stopped on the dirt shoulder with its rear end angled toward the road, and a dark SUV approaches rapidly from behind in the adjacent lane; by frame f8 (56.0 s), the SUV has made contact or is in immediate proximity, indicating a rear-end collision or near-collision event.
A blue minivan overtakes on the left and collides with a dark SUV that is attempting to re-enter the paved road from the dirt shoulder, causing both vehicles to spin and kick up dust.

Following the initial collision, the dark SUV continues to skid across the road, rotating and coming to rest sideways in the dirt shoulder, while the blue minivan also slides and stops nearby; a large dust cloud obscures details but confirms ongoing post-impact motion.

A white semi-truck approaches the accident scene from behind and slows to a stop; the dark SUV remains stationary on the shoulder, and a person exits the vehicle and walks toward the roadside, indicating the crash has concluded and occupants are assessing the situation.

A dark SUV loses control on a dirt shoulder, veers sharply right, and slides sideways across the road, kicking up dust; it collides with or is struck by a black sedan in the adjacent lane, causing both vehicles to skid and come to rest partially off the paved road.

A white semi-truck approaches the accident scene from behind and stops abruptly just before the disabled vehicles, avoiding a secondary collision; its presence confirms the severity and suddenness of the prior crash.

A man exits the right-side vehicle and walks toward the other car; he appears to approach the driver’s side and gestures, but no physical contact, striking, grappling, or mutual combat is visible in any frame.

A dark SUV is seen veering sharply right off the paved road onto the dirt shoulder, kicking up dust, indicating a loss of control or evasive maneuver; a second dark sedan is visible ahead on the road, and a large truck is partially visible on the far left. The SUV’s position across the lane boundary and dynamic dust plume confirm an active incident.

The dark SUV remains stationary on the dirt shoulder, angled across the road edge, with significant dust still settling. A man in a blue jacket walks from the roadside toward the SUV, approaching it by frame f10 (77.0 s). This confirms the vehicle has come to rest after the crash/loss of control, constituting a post-impact accident scene.

The man reaches the driver’s side of the stopped SUV and appears to interact with it (e.g., opening door or checking occupant) between 76.5–79.5 s. The SUV remains immobile, confirming the accident is ongoing/resolved but not yet cleared. No secondary collision occurs in this interval.
A blue semi-truck collides head-on with a white bus on a two-lane road, causing immediate severe deformation and dust/debris cloud.
Post-collision phase: the vehicles are entangled and sliding; the camera vehicle’s windshield is shattered, and debris litters the road as the scene stabilizes in the aftermath of the crash.
